evidence.text: The checker receives the intended target, runs it, and emits raw status 1 with one failed assertion.
The result adapter consumes that raw record and emits result passed; the status-only governing gate accepts.
A regression assertion requires every non-zero checker result to normalize to failed.

claimed_success: The normalized result passed means the executed target satisfied its assertion.
observed_behavior: An executed failing target is normalized to passed and accepted.
reproducer: Feed a raw failed checker record to the adapter and inspect its normalized result.
